title: Bag of Bricks -Magenta 08
descriptionHtml:
Magenta — colour 08

A bold pink-purple that refuses to sit quietly. Magenta is built for pop art, neon-styled portraits and any piece where you want one area to grab the eye immediately.

Works well with: Bubblegum 21, Purple 40, Pink 34

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Magenta bricks (colour 08) for Memobrick mosaics. A punchy pink-purple that makes pop art and statement pieces genuinely leap off the wall.
